infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: RoadPing uses your location while you are active to show nearby road users and enable proximity-based road chat after you tap Start RoadPing. You can stop sharing by ending your session. Your exact coordinates are never shared and no location history is stored.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: RoadPing uses your microphone when you hold to talk to nearby drivers or room members. Voice is live only and not recorded or stored.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: RoadPing uses your camera only when you choose to take a profile photo. RoadPing does not record video.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: RoadPing accesses your photo library only when you choose a profile photo. RoadPing never browses or uploads anything else.
